critical_code_review_comments: routers/digest.py cron_digest: when settings.enabled=false or recipients empty, it returns 'skipped' but does NOT insert the run_id into digest_runs — so a retry with the same X-Webhook-Id after re-enabling will fail to dedupe. Minor edge case; current UI/tests not affected.

services/digest.py send_digest is scheduled via BackgroundTasks AFTER insert_one — if the server crashes between insert and the task completing, the run is stuck in 'queued' status with no retry logic. Acceptable for MVP; worth noting.

routers/board.py urgency_key: inside each column, no-due-date units go last and dated units sort asc by date — matches the review spec. However the top-level board doesn't surface 'overdue' as a column itself, just ordering within existing status columns. Confirmed with iteration-3 TestBoardUrgency.
frontend LoginPage auth-switch-* testids differ from a prior convention (auth-toggle-*) — not a bug, but keep an eye on consumers of these testids in docs/notes.

POFormDialog LineItemsEditor: po-line-remove-{i} is disabled when only one line remains (good); indices (not stable keys) are used for the TESTID even though li.key is used for React keys. For stable testing semantics, consider using li.key in the data-testid as well (works today since removal reindexes DOM, but testing framework must know to re-query after remove).
